editorial:
Imagine being eighteen and finding out your parents already picked your spouse. That is exactly what happens to Arga, a young guy who has no interest in getting married so early. He gets thrown into a whirlwind of emotions when he is forced to marry the daughter of his father's best friend to fulfill an old promise. The movie feels like a rollercoaster of teenage angst and sudden romance, mixing high school vibes with the heavy pressure of family expectations. You will feel for Arga as he tries to balance his own desires with the rules he is forced to follow, all while dealing with the spark that starts to grow between him and his new wife.

The acting is surprisingly natural, and the chemistry between the leads makes the romance feel real rather than forced. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the action scenes keep things exciting and break up the drama. If you love stories about young love and family secrets, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the vibrant colors, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: After plenty of fighting and misunderstandings, Arga and his wife finally realize they actually love each other. They stop worrying about the forced nature of their marriage and choose to be together on their own terms. The story wraps up with them accepting their relationship, proving that a bad start can lead to a happy ending. It ends on a sweet note, showing that love can grow even in the strangest situations.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen romance and family drama.
